codeSnippets.output: A centered, full-viewport hero that scales to any screen.
Responsive feature cards that wrap automatically below 240px per column.

exercise.instruction: Complete the landing page: center .hero as a flex column with align-items: center and justify-content: center. Give the button a :hover rule that transitions the background to a brighter color over 0.2s. Make .features a grid with grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) and a 24px gap.
exercise.starterCode:
Build Faster with CSS

Everything you learned — variables, flexbox, grid, and polish — in one production-ready page.

Instant Theming

Colors and spacing come from CSS variables.

Responsive by Default

Columns wrap themselves with auto-fit.

Polished Interactions

Hover states transition smoothly.
hints: Hint 1: .hero { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
Hint 3: .features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; }

quiz.question: What makes repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) responsive without media queries?
options: columns shrink until 240px, then wrap onto new rows
it hides columns on small screens

quiz.question: Why add a transition to the :hover state?
options: transitions are required for hover to work
transitions animate the change smoothly instead of snapping
transitions make the page load faster

quiz.question: Why is flexbox the right tool for the hero section?
options: the hero is a single centered column stack
